name: issue_to_pr_publication_plan
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

deliveryOutcome.description: Delivery state from issue_to_pr_delivery/issue_to_pr_verified_delivery. Non-string or absent is treated as "implementation_unavailable".

agentAuthoredTest.description: Whether the final test_cycle accepted a coding-agent-authored test (no pre-existing test covered the change). Forces draft=true even when deliveryOutcome is "passed", as defense in depth alongside the red/green check that already proved the test isn't vacuous.

publish.description: Always the literal string "true", matching the workflow's SWITCH-value convention.

draft.description: True unless deliveryOutcome is exactly "passed" and agentAuthoredTest is not true; whether the PR should be opened as a draft.

reason.description: Empty when passed and not agent-authored; "agent-authored test" when passed but agentAuthoredTest is true; otherwise "delivery outcome: <deliveryOutcome>".

agentAuthoredTest.description: Echoes whether a coding-agent-authored test was used; true only when input agentAuthoredTest was exactly true.
